info.title: Aurora Listener API
info.description: In-development, path-free API for Aurora web and future dedicated listener applications. Administrative and library-management operations remain outside v1.

listenerAuth.description: Aurora web JWT or a dedicated aurora_app_ listener key.

editionLabel.description: Edition or release variant such as "Deluxe Edition", when the album is one of several editions.

tracks.description: Credited tracks first, then tracks on albums the artist owns as album artist without a performer credit.

ownedAlbums.description: Albums owned by the Various Artists pseudo-artist. Always empty for real artists.

ownerClientId.description: Deprecated: the client that last created or claimed the session. A session belongs to its user; any of their devices may change it.

id.description: The device that plays the session (its client ID).

kind.description: browser: the device plays the session itself. cast: the device sends it to a Cast device it controls; `name` is the Cast device's. receiver: the Cast receiver plays the session itself, with its own credential; a controller claims it, and `name` is the Cast device's.

generation.description: Grant generation; goes up on every claim.

castSessionId.description: kind cast: the Cast session the output sends to; kind receiver: the Cast session the receiver runs in. When the server knows it (it is not kept across a server restart).

status.description: active: reporting. unreachable: silent for over a minute, last state kept; only a report or a new claim changes it. ended: the output itself reported stopped, idle or error.

queueEntryId.description: The entry the output is playing. Position belongs to this entry only.

reportedAt.description: Server time the report was accepted; interpolate from here while playing.

output.description: The device currently playing the session, if any.

infinity.description: Infinity: the server keeps a few upcoming entries, chosen by the recommendation engine, while a Cast receiver plays the session itself.

token.description: Output credential: a short-lived token bound to this session and grant. Keep it in memory only. For a receiver output, a receiver credential, which the receiver itself uses.

renewableUntil.description: Receiver credentials only: the receiver may renew its own credential (POST …/output/renew) until then, 24 hours after a controller issued it.

accepted.description: True when sent to the output; false for a repeated requestId.
False when the report was older than one already accepted (by seq) and was dropped.

subsonicProviderLoveSyncEnabled.description: Mirror stars from OpenSubsonic clients to Last.fm and MusicBrainz. Defaults to true.

id.description: The calling client: the X-Aurora-Client-Id it sent, or a server-assigned id.

skipped.description: True when nothing was generated, for example because a refresh is already running or no LLM is configured.

reason.description: Why no radio can be built, when not eligible.

sessionHistoryTrackIds.description: Playback-start history, oldest to newest, including the playing track. Merged after older server history; does not record plays.

exclude.description: Track IDs already queued or otherwise excluded. Exclusions survive similarity relaxation and fallback.

seedTrackIds.description: The end of the play queue, oldest to newest, ending with the track the recommendation will follow. When present it steers the recommendation instead of playback history; history still prevents repeats. Only the last 10 are used.

InfinitySettings.description: Per-request overrides for saved user tuning. Omitted values use saved settings or engine defaults.

requestId.description: Idempotency key for the whole patch; kept 24 hours.

entryIds.description: Client-proposed queue entry IDs, one unique UUID per track. Omitted, the server generates them.

index.description: Legacy position form. Give exactly one of index or afterEntryId.

afterEntryId.description: Insert after this entry; null inserts at the head. Give exactly one of index or afterEntryId.

entryIds.description: Client-proposed queue entry IDs, one unique UUID per track. Omitted, the server generates them.

toIndex.description: Legacy position form. Give exactly one of toIndex or afterEntryId.

afterEntryId.description: Move after this entry; null moves to the head. Give exactly one of toIndex or afterEntryId.

kind.description: browser: the device plays the session itself. cast: the device sends it to a Cast device it controls; `name` is the Cast device's. receiver: the Cast receiver plays the session itself, with its own credential; a controller claims it, and `name` is the Cast device's.

castSessionId.description: kind cast: the Cast session this device sends to, so another device can tell joining it from starting a new one. kind receiver (required): the Cast session the receiver runs in; the output ID becomes `receiver:<castSessionId>`.

seq.description: Increases with every report within one grant; a report not above the last accepted one is dropped.

outputId.description: Optional; must match the output credential.

outputGeneration.description: Optional; must match the output credential.

requestId.description: A repeated requestId is accepted once.

outputId.description: The output this command is for: the session's current output.id.

outputGeneration.description: Its current output.generation; a newer claim makes the command stale.

entryId.description: Play this queue entry from its start.

revision.description: The output first adopts the session queue at this revision or later.

entryId.description: Then plays this entry from its start.

get.description: Use a short-lived sse token (or a receiver credential, which hears only its own session) in the query string because EventSource cannot set Authorization headers; a full session token is refused. Each event's data is JSON `{id, type, occurredAt, data}`. Types: playbackSession.created / updated / handedOff / deleted (fetch the session when its revision is newer), playbackSession.progress (every accepted output report: `{sessionId, revision, outputId, generation, report}`; live only, never replayed), playlist.changed, annotation.changed, playbackSession.command (to the output: `{sessionId, outputId, generation, requestId, issuedBy, command}`; live only), library.revision, playbackSync.changed (`{enabled}`: whether the playback-session API works for this account now), and resync.required (the replay window was lost: re-fetch everything).
